summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC., a Taiwan-based OSAT provider listed on Nasdaq (IMOS) and the Taiwan Stock Exchange, filed a Form 6-K announcing a US$0.760 cash dividend per ADS from capital surplus, to be distributed on July 24, 2026. After Citibank's depositary fees, holders receive approximately US$0.740 per ADS. This is a routine cash distribution, not an extraordinary dividend or return of capital tied to a strategic event. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing includes no structural details beyond the per-ADS amount and payment date. What to watch: verify the ex-dividend date and any Taiwan withholding tax implications for U.S. holders.
